description_target.ambiguity_notes: The blue edge and the relative placement of cyan versus the two small pictures rotate together. Ring occupancy varies freely; it controls only the per-slice counts.
generator_parameters: main and small lattice occupancy patterns
negative_constraints: Do not count the eight pixels within a hollow ring; count each occupied coarse-lattice cell once.
Do not merge the two small colors or reverse their aligned slice positions.
Do not rotate or mirror the compressed output independently of the main lattice orientation.
solution_steps: Ignore background zero and the full blue edge marker, and decode each remaining color as hollow 3x3 rings on a four-cell stride.
Use cyan as the seven-slice main lattice and determine whether its long axis is horizontal or vertical.
For every long-axis slice, count occupied cyan rings and occupied rings in the aligned small lattice, if any.
Pad all slices to the largest combined count, keep the small color adjacent to cyan, and put cyan on the side away from the blue edge.
Transpose the list of stacks only when the main lattice is horizontal.
description_target.target_text: Decode the nonzero pictures as hollow 3x3 rings on a four-cell lattice. Cyan (8) is the seven-slice main picture; the two other non-blue colors are three-slice pictures aligned with its two ends. Along the main picture's long axis, count the occupied cyan rings and the occupied aligned small-picture rings in each slice. Convert those counts into equal-height stacked bars: cyan occupies the side away from the full blue edge marker, the matching small color touches cyan, and zeros supply any padding. Return one stack per slice, transposing the stack array when the main lattice is horizontal.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; Hollow 4x4 blocks on a coarse lattice form one big cyan(8) group
 ;; and small colored groups; a blue(1) bar marks the gravity edge.
 ;; Per lattice slice (column of the cyan group when it is wide, row
 ;; when tall), count the cyan blocks and the overlapping small-group
 ;; blocks, and emit stacked bars: cyan pressed toward the blue bar,
 ;; the small color on top, empty above.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (analyze col)  ;; (color bh bw blocks r1 c1) on the lattice
       (let* ((cells (find-color g col))
              (r1 (min-list (map first cells)))
              (c1 (min-list (map second cells)))
              (bh (quotient (+ (- (max-list (map first cells)) r1) 2) 4))
              (bw (quotient (+ (- (max-list (map second cells)) c1) 2) 4)))
         (list col bh bw
               (map (lambda (br)
                      (map (lambda (bc)
                             (if (= (at g (+ r1 (* br 4)) (+ c1 (* bc 4)))
                                    col)
                                 1 0))
                           (range 0 bw)))
                    (range 0 bh))
               r1 c1)))
     (define (i-color i) (nth i 0))
     (define (i-bh i) (nth i 1))
     (define (i-bw i) (nth i 2))
     (define (i-blocks i) (nth i 3))
     (define (i-r1 i) (nth i 4))
     (define (i-c1 i) (nth i 5))
     (define infos
       (map analyze (filter (lambda (c) (and (not (= c 0)) (not (= c 1))))
                            (grid-colors g))))
     (define main (find (lambda (i) (= (i-color i) 8)) infos))
     (define smalls (filter (lambda (i) (not (= (i-color i) 8))) infos))
     (define horizontal? (> (i-bw main) (i-bh main)))
     (define main-at-end  ;; cyan sits past the smalls, away from the bar
       (if horizontal?
           (> (- (i-r1 main)
                 (quotient (apply + (map i-r1 smalls)) (length smalls)))
              0)
           (> (- (i-c1 main)
                 (quotient (apply + (map i-c1 smalls)) (length smalls)))
              0)))
     (define (col-sum blocks i n)
       (sum-list (map (lambda (br) (nth (nth blocks br) i)) (range 0 n))))
     (define (slice-counts i)  ;; (cyan-count small-count small-color)
       (let* ((m-count (if horizontal?
                           (col-sum (i-blocks main) i (i-bh main))
                           (sum-list (nth (i-blocks main) i))))
              (s-info (find (lambda (si)
                              (let ((off (if horizontal?
                                             (quotient (- (i-c1 si)
                                                          (i-c1 main))
                                                       4)
                                             (quotient (- (i-r1 si)
                                                          (i-r1 main))
                                                       4))))
                                (and (>= i off)
                                     (< i (+ off (if horizontal?
                                                     (i-bw si)
                                                     (i-bh si)))))))
                            smalls)))
         (list m-count
               (if s-info
                   (if horizontal?
                       (col-sum (i-blocks s-info)
                                (- i (quotient (- (i-c1 s-info)
                                                  (i-c1 main))
                                               4))
                                (i-bh s-info))
                       (sum-list (nth (i-blocks s-info)
                                      (- i (quotient (- (i-r1 s-info)
                                                        (i-r1 main))
                                                     4)))))
                   0)
               (if s-info (i-color s-info) 0))))
     (define n-slices (if horizontal? (i-bw main) (i-bh main)))
     (define slices (map slice-counts (range 0 n-slices)))
     (define max-h (max-of (lambda (s) (+ (first s) (second s))) slices))
     (define (bar triple)  ;; one stacked slice, padded to max-h
       (let ((m (make-list (first triple) 8))
             (s (make-list (second triple) (third triple)))
             (p (make-list (- max-h (+ (first triple) (second triple)))
                           0)))
         (if main-at-end (append p s m) (append m s p))))
     (define stacks (map bar slices))
     (if horizontal?
         (map (lambda (r) (map (lambda (c) (nth (nth stacks c) r))
                               (range 0 n-slices)))
              (range 0 max-h))
         stacks))))
